name: sculpture-3d
description: Three-dimensional art and sculptural thinking for art education. Covers additive and subtractive sculptural processes, armature construction, modeling in clay, carving principles, casting and moldmaking, assemblage and found-object sculpture, installation art as expanded sculpture, and the conceptual transition from pictorial to spatial thinking. Use when working with three-dimensional media, analyzing sculptural form, understanding spatial composition, or investigating the relationship between sculpture and site.
